openingQuery: Hand-thrown ceramics for a slower morning routine

chat.content: Hand-thrown ceramics for a slower morning routine

Three worth reaching for: the Stoneware Pour-Over Set ($95) - hand-thrown, ash-grey, built for a slow pour. The Ceramic Tumblers in charcoal ($78) pair with it - same kiln run, no two quite alike. And the Jute Placemats, Set of 4 ($68) under both of them finishes the table.

toolCalls.description: Semantic search: hand-thrown ceramics + morning ritual
toolCalls.sql:
SELECT name, brand, price, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity
FROM product_catalog
WHERE category ILIKE '%Kitchen and table%'
  AND quantity > 0
ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector
LIMIT 10;
toolCalls.resultSummary: 3 slow-craft pieces returned by cosine distance

sections.title: The ritual
paragraphs: Theo arrived looking for ceramics with patina, not polish. The Personalization Agent, with the-makers-shelf skill loaded, returned three pieces from the same kiln register - pour-over, tumblers, mat - a composed table rather than a set of objects.
